name: borowka-pwa
description: Borowka PWA - system ewidencji zbiorow, sprzedazy i rozliczen zbieraczy.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:pwa
scripts.build:pwa: node scripts/ensure-temp-dir.mjs && cross-env TMPDIR=.tmp TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp vite build
scripts.test: cross-env TMPDIR=.tmp TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp vitest run src tests/scripts
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/firebase-cli.mjs emulators:exec --project demo-borowka-pwa-dev --only firestore "npm run test:integration:unit"
scripts.test:integration:unit: cross-env TMPDIR=.tmp TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp vitest run tests/integration
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/firebase-cli.mjs emulators:exec --project demo-borowka-pwa-dev --only firestore "npm run test:rules:unit"
scripts.test:rules:unit: cross-env TMPDIR=.tmp TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp vitest run tests/rules
scripts.test:e2e: cross-env TMPDIR=.tmp TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:ui: cross-env TMPDIR=.tmp TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp playwright test --ui
scripts.test:watch: node scripts/ensure-temp-dir.mjs && cross-env TMPDIR=.tmp TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp vitest src
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
